state_policy.provider_month_price: last available provider-date median price within each provider/generation/pricing_type/calendar month
state_policy.on_demand_breadth: for providers present in consecutive months, (+1 up, -1 down, 0 unchanged) mean; requires minimum_common_on_demand_providers
state_policy.on_demand_change_dispersion: median absolute deviation of paired-provider monthly log changes; descriptive, not part of the primary gate
state_policy.exact_spot_discount: 1 - spot/on_demand only when both pricing types exist for the same provider, generation and exact snapshot date; monthly state uses the last exact paired date and then the cross-provider median; no cross-date pairing

forecast_policy.breadth_ols: causal one-feature OLS of forward target log return on current on-demand provider repricing breadth, trained only on same-generation states whose outcomes are fully observed by the forecast origin
forecast_policy.breadth_ols_transport: same fixed OLS relationship trained only on other-generation H100/H200 states; B200 states are excluded from training
forecast_policy.reliability_ols_secondary: separate causal one-feature OLS on exact spot-discount median, reported only when support exists and never used to rescue the primary breadth gate
forecast_policy.depreciation: causal target-generation log-price slope through origin with positive slope clipped to zero

cache_policy.panel_purpose: reusable bounded input for later provider/reliability discriminators without re-downloading the active 967MB archive

decision_rule.if_insufficient: record exact support deficit and do not lower thresholds
